lit-mr-01-c4.text: Faculty of English / Dept of Anglo-Saxon, Norse and Celtic, University of Cambridge. Old English - The Battle of Maldon: Passage 1. Cambridge Old English spoken word pages (asnc.cam.ac.uk).

lit-mr-03-c1.text: Poets.org - Academy of American Poets (2007). Dante Alighieri. Poets.org.
lit-mr-03-c1.quote: Guided at first by the character of Virgil, and later by his beloved Beatrice
